settings/companionPort.title: Pairing port
settings/companionPort.body: Port this Switch listens on for pairing pushes from the companion app.

settings/pairBtn.title: Pair with companion
settings/pairBtn.body: Show a 4-digit code and wait for the desktop companion to push your PSN credentials over the network.

settings/credOnlineId.title: Online ID
settings/credOnlineId.body: The PSN online ID linked to your credentials.

settings/credRefreshToken.title: Refresh token
settings/credRefreshToken.body: Long-lived token used to renew access.

settings/credTokenExpiry.title: Token expiry
settings/credTokenExpiry.body: When the current access token expires.

settings/credDuid.title: DUID
settings/credDuid.body: Device identifier used for remote registration.

settings/clearPsnBtn.title: Clear credentials
settings/clearPsnBtn.body: Remove all stored PSN token data.

settings/refreshTokenBtn.title: Refresh token
settings/refreshTokenBtn.body: Renew the access token using the refresh token.

settings/trophiesEnabled.title: Show trophy page
settings/trophiesEnabled.body: When on, press L to view this account's trophies. Turn off to hide the trophy page entirely.
